change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, 저장된 기관 제공 문구에는 이(가) 기재되어 있습니다. 대상은 이며, 이 요약은 준비 파일에 저장된 공식 문구 범위만 반영합니다.

impact_summary.value: FDA는 조사·불만 및 CAPA 관리의 미흡과 장비 세척 문제로 교차오염 위험이 있으며, CGMP 위반으로 제품이 부정한 것으로 간주된다고 밝혔습니다. 위반이 해소되고 CGMP 준수가 확인될 때까지 신규 신청 또는 보완 신청의 승인이 보류될 수 있고, 미국 수입이 거부될 수도 있습니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).
Inadequate removal of drug residues during cleaning can cause cross-contamination in subsequently manufactured drugs on the same equipment.
FDA may withhold approval of new applications or supplements listing your firm as a drug manufacturer until any violations are completely addressed and we confirm your compliance with CGMP.

affected_work.value: Cohance Lifesciences Limited의 완제의약품 제조시설에서 일탈·불만·규격일탈 조사와 CAPA, 다품목 제조 장비의 세척 및 세척 검증·밸리데이션, 장비 변경관리, 미국 시장용 제품 제조·출하 재개가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm failed to thoroughly investigate any unexplained discrepancy or failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications, whether or not the batch has already been distributed (21 CFR 211.192).
You failed to adequately clean and maintain your nondedicated drug manufacturing equipment.
In response to this letter, clarify when you intend to resume manufacturing of drugs for the U.S. market at this facility.

recommendation.value: FDA는 문제 사례가 있는 보관검체의 분석시험 결과와 제품 품질 문제 대응 계획, 조사·CAPA 및 세척 프로그램의 독립 평가와 시정 계획, 세척 밸리데이션 개선 및 관련 SOP 요약을 제출하라고 요구합니다. 미국 시장용 제조를 재개하기 전에 FDA 사무소에 통지하고, 위반을 신속히 시정하며, 시정조치가 15 영업일 내 완료되지 않으면 지연 사유와 완료 일정을 밝혀 서면 회신해야 합니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: A summary of analytical testing, including dissolution, of reserve samples exhibiting crumbling, disintegrating, pitted (b)(4) tablets USP (b)(4) mg, and an action plan to address this product-quality issue, such as reformulation studies or additional transportation studies.

Before you resume any manufacturing operations regulated under the FD&C Act, notify this office. You are responsible for resolving all deficiencies and systemic flaws to ensure your firm is capable of ongoing CGMP compliance.

After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. 1 Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence. In response to this letter, you may provide additional information for our consideration as we continue to assess your activities and practices. If you cannot complete corrective actions within 15 working days, state your reasons for delay and your schedule for completion.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days.
